answer: The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. Before the stamp comes a 3-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point.
